tokenizer.source: the GGUF's drama3.tokenizer.* only (no tokenizer.json on disk)

codec-reference.transcript: Every morning I walk along the river and listen to the birds.
codec-reference.padding: DAC.encode pads the samples on the right with zeros to 204800 (a multiple of 2048); frames = ceil(samples / 2048)

samples.note: the clip resampled 24000 -> 44100 Hz by torchaudio.functional.resample defaults

encoder/enc.in_conv.note: encoder.block.0, the causal 7-tap input conv (1 -> 64); [rows, channels]

encoder/enc.blk.0.res.0.note: encoder.block.1.block.0, the first ResidualUnit (dilation 1) of encoder block 0; [rows, channels]

encoder/enc.blk.0.note: encoder block 0 (3 ResidualUnits, Snake, causal stride-2 conv 64 -> 128); [rows, channels]

encoder/enc.blk.3.down.note: encoder block 3's stride-8 conv (512 -> 1024), before its transformer; [rows, channels]

encoder/enc.blk.3.note: encoder block 3 after its 4-layer causal windowed (512) transformer; [rows, channels]

encoder/enc.out.note: the encoder's output: Snake then the causal 3-tap conv (1024 -> 1024), the latent z; [rows, channels]

encoder/q.down.0.note: quantizer.downsample.0 after its ConvNeXt block; [rows, channels]

encoder/q.pre.note: the quantizer's 8-layer causal windowed (128) pre-transformer: what the VQs read; [rows, channels]

encoder/q.latents.note: each VQ's in_proj output z_e (the 8-dim latent before the L2-normalized nearest-codeword search), [frame][codebook * 8 + d], codebook 0 the semantic one, 1-9 the residual ones (each reads the residual left by the earlier ones)

codes.note: the codes DAC.encode returns, [frame][codebook]: 0 semantic (< 4096), 1-9 residual (< 1024)

decoder/q.z.note: from_indices on `codes`: the quantizer decode's sum of the 10 codebook vectors after their out_proj (post_module's input); [rows, channels]

decoder/q.post.note: from_indices on `codes`: the 8-layer causal windowed (128) post-transformer; [rows, channels]

decoder/q.up.0.note: from_indices on `codes`: quantizer.upsample.0: causal transposed conv x2 + ConvNeXt; [rows, channels]

decoder/q.up.1.note: from_indices on `codes`: quantizer.upsample.1: causal transposed conv x2 + ConvNeXt; the decoder's input; [rows, channels]

decoder/dec.in_conv.note: from_indices on `codes`: decoder.model.0, the causal 7-tap conv (1024 -> 1536); [rows, channels]

decoder/dec.blk.0.up.note: from_indices on `codes`: decoder block 0's Snake + causal transposed conv x8 (1536 -> 768); [rows, channels]

decoder/dec.blk.0.note: from_indices on `codes`: decoder block 0 after its 3 ResidualUnits; [rows, channels]

decoder/dec.out_conv.note: from_indices on `codes`: Snake then the causal 7-tap conv (96 -> 1), before tanh; [rows, channels]

decoder/samples.note: from_indices's waveform (after tanh), its first and last 2 frames; the whole's SHA-256 and RMS are in the case

codec-window.input: codec-reference's samples twice over, end to end
codec-window.windows: the encoder transformer runs over 800 rows (window 512); the quantizer transformers over 200 frames (window 128)

encoder/enc.blk.3.note: the last 16 rows of encoder block 3 after its 4-layer causal windowed (512) transformer

encoder/q.pre.note: the last 16 rows of the quantizer's 8-layer causal windowed (128) pre-transformer: what the VQs read

codes.note: DAC.encode's codes of the doubled clip, [frame][codebook]

decoder/q.post.note: from_indices on `codes`: the last 16 rows of the post-transformer

decoder/samples.note: the last 2 frames of from_indices's waveform

clone-fox.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
clone-fox.reference_text: Every morning I walk along the river and listen to the birds.
clone-fox.frames_note: frames.i32 [row][main, c0..c9]: a text row is [token id, 0 x 10] (Fish's build_drama3_prompt), a semantic row [248099 + c0, c0..c9]; the prompt rows end at <|voice|>, then the continuation rows are the reference's first 24 frames, teacher-forced
clone-fox.positions: row r is at position r (one sequence from 0)
clone-fox.logits_columns: column j is drama3.output.token_ids[j] (j 0: EOS 248046, j 1 + c: semantic code c)

names.output: lm_head.weight rows drama3.output.token_ids (EOS, then the semantic band)
names.blk.N.attn_q, blk.N.attn_gate: model.layers.N.self_attn.q_proj.weight: per head h, rows [h*512, h*512+256) = attn_q rows [h*256, h*256+256), rows [h*512+256, h*512+512) = attn_gate's
names.ad.codebook_embd: codebook_embeddings.weight rows [4096, 40960): GGUF row (k-1)*4096 + c is codebook k >= 1, code c (Fish's codebook 0 rows, never read, are absent)

clone-fox.tower_note: FishOmniAudioDecoder.prefill(hidden = backbone/norm rows 0..R-2, positions, frames[r], next_frames = frames[r + 1]): row r runs the shared layers on code c0 of frame r + 1 (layer 0 adding the summed codebook 2-9 embeddings of frame r when frame r is semantic), then residual layer j on c_j of frame r + 1; head j on residual layer j's output predicts c_{j+1} of frame r + 1. Every tower layer attends over all rows 0..r, text rows included (their e is 0)

backbone/inputs.note: embed_backbone: text rows token_embd[id]; semantic rows (token_embd[main] + codebook_embd[c1]) / sqrt(2)

backbone/norm.note: after output_norm: the hidden the lm head and the tower read

backbone/logits.note: the 4,097 `output` logits per pinned row (row r predicts row r + 1's main token)

tower/shared.note: the shared stack's output (after shared layer 3) at tower_rows

tower/residual.note: [row][j] residual layer j's output at tower_rows

tower/logits.note: [row][j] codebook head j's 4,096 logits (code j + 1 of the next frame) at tower_rows
